SnackTray 1.4.0

  • SnackTray is now free. The trial and license keys are gone, and every feature works for everyone, with no key to enter and no time limit.
  • To everyone who bought a license: thank you very much. There is nothing more you need to do.
  • If you would like to support SnackTray from here, the menu bar menu now has Donate on Ko-fi. Settings has an About tab in place of the License tab, with the same link, and About SnackTray in the menu now opens it.
  • If your trial had run out, everything it locked is back.
